explanations: Parallel starts each task's span from context.Background() instead of the ctx it was given. Background carries no SpanContext, so StartSpan treats every fan-out span as the root of a brand new trace, and the spans below it (assign_courier, quote_fare) inherit that new trace ID. The handler itself and the outgoing headers are fine, which is why the symptom only appears for work done in goroutines. Passing the caller's ctx makes the per-task spans children of handle_order in the same trace.
